description: This file contains optimized matrix multiplication functions using PyTorch's Dynamo and Inductor, along with benchmarking code for different fusion types and shapes.

classes.name: Func
classes.description: Contains optimized matrix multiplication and related functions decorated with torch._dynamo.optimize for inductor compilation.

methods.name: mm
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication using torch.mm, optimized with torch._dynamo.

methods.name: mm_add
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication and adds bias, optimized with torch._dynamo.

methods.name: mm_relu
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication followed by ReLU activation, optimized with torch._dynamo.

methods.name: mm_add_relu
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication, adds bias, then applies ReLU, optimized with torch._dynamo.

methods.name: bench
methods.description: Runs benchmarking for different matrix shapes and fusion types, measuring performance of inductor-optimized matmuls.
